description: pipeline.rs:721-724 and rnews_main.rs:292: SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap_or_default().as_millis() silently falls back to 0 on a clock before Unix epoch. For ingested_at_ms (the GC ledger timestamp), storing 0 means the GC grace period has already expired at the moment of insert — the decision comment at lines 705-713 explicitly warns that a backwards timestamp would let GC immediately evict a just-ingested article. The fallback must either tracing::error! + return Err(PipelineError::Transient(...)) or use .expect() with a message that would appear in logs. The same pattern occurs in rnews_main.rs:292 (per-article HLC timestamp). Idiomatic fix: .map_err(|e| PipelineError::Transient(format!("system clock before epoch: {e}")))?   or at minimum: .unwrap_or_else(|_| { tracing::error!("system clock before Unix epoch; ingested_at_ms=0 will corrupt GC"); 0 })
title: pipeline: unwrap_or_default on SystemTime silently stores ingested_at_ms=0
